import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)

# Display the first few rows and the data types
df_info = df.info()
df_head = df.head()

df_info, df_head

# Replace anomalous values in StayDuration with NaN
df['StayDuration'] = df['StayDuration'].replace(-999, pd.NA)

# Calculate average length of stay for readmitted and not readmitted patients
average_stay = df.groupby('Returned')['StayDuration'].mean()

average_stay
